correctness.rationale: On characteristic-two translation x_i=y_i+t, e_3 has no t terms; eliminating e_1 gives F=(sum z_i)^3+sum z_i^3 and gradient squares of four independent forms. Hence the base surface is smooth, the cone has one ordinary triple vertex, and its Jacobian local algebra is the four-square complete intersection of length 16. The plane Fano scheme equals the lines on the base surface: the standalone exact verifier exhaustively checks 35 F2 and 357 F4 Grassmannian lines, obtains 15 and 27, 12 in six nonrational Frobenius pairs; the standard 27-line theorem supplies global completeness. The normal sequence and exact 27 nonzero normal determinants show every plane is a reduced étale point. Odd-characteristic signs classify all ten nodes; direct Hessian determinant 16 certifies ordinary double points.

value.rationale: The exact scheme-theoretic degeneration of the integral symmetric Segre cubic is a natural boundary calculation of central classical/moduli geometry: ten characteristic-zero nodes collide to a triple vertex whose Jacobian length is sixteen, and a 15-plane arrangement becomes a reduced étale 27-plane scheme with exact 15 F2 and 6 F4 decomposition. These arithmetic and local invariants distinguish a degenerate coefficient-marked model from Dolgachev’s ten-node good model and provide reproducible data for comparing reductions; not merely recomputation of 27 lines.
